description: This file defines the LeaveConfigurationService class in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. The class extends ConfigService and provides methods to access and modify leave-related configuration settings such as entitlement consumption strategy, work schedule implementation, pending leave inclusion, leave period status, and whether the leave period has been set.

classes.name: LeaveConfigurationService
classes.description: A service class that manages leave configuration settings, extending the core ConfigService to provide specific methods for retrieving and setting leave-related configuration values.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
methods.description: Returns the leave entitlement consumption algorithm strategy as a string.

methods.name: getWorkScheduleImplementation
methods.description: Retrieves the current leave work schedule implementation setting.

methods.name: includePendingLeaveInBalance
methods.description: Determines whether pending leave should be included in the leave balance calculation, returning true or false.

methods.name: setLeavePeriodStatus
methods.description: Sets the leave period status using an integer value, corresponding to predefined status constants.

methods.name: getLeavePeriodStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current leave period status as an integer, corresponding to specific leave period state constants.

methods.name: setLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Sets whether the leave period has been defined, based on a boolean value.

methods.name: isLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Checks if the leave period has been set, returning true if it has been defined.
